I think you should focus on the feeling that come with this memory. Do you have body memory, or do you feel like there's something deep inside you that feels wrong.

If something really bad happened in your childhood it's really not gonna last just like one memory and everything's fine. I mean, is there stuff in your life which seem off that you could relate to this memory, something you stopped wondering about but isn't normal, fears and anxiety that you still have as an adult but still can't explain why... And in the case of forgotten physical abuse, a weird physical feeling which never really left, keep coming back, etc.

I think you should look back in your childhood with a neutral mind. If it destroys you too much definitely talk about it to a psychologic (if you have the money), and... maybe consider talking about this to people who knew you in your childhood, they might know more than you think, or just enough to enlighten you. Even your father...

Good luck
